Stay terms. Last updated: 08/11/2026.

## 1. Operator and scope
These terms supplement those of your Airbnb booking and govern your stay at «Il giardino di Rosa» (Via Filippo Turati, 29a, 87060 Mirto Crosia (CS)), operated by [to be completed]. National ID code (CIN): IT078047C2AXCJH7XN.

## 2. How to book
Bookings are made **exclusively on Airbnb**, where before confirming you see dates, room, number of guests, total price (with any extra costs) and cancellation terms. The contract is concluded under Airbnb's terms. This website does not conclude contracts or take payments.

## 3. Prices
Prices are those shown by Airbnb at booking time and include breakfast. Any municipal **tourist tax** ([to be completed]) is due under municipal rules and the instructions given at booking.

## 4. Payment
Booking and payment take place on Airbnb under the conditions shown on the platform. This website does not take payments.

## 5. Cancellation and changes
Cancellation terms depend on the rate you choose and are shown by Airbnb for your dates before you book. For anything else write to ilgiardinodirosa53@gmail.com.

## 6. Right of withdrawal
Under Art. 59(1)(n) of the Italian Consumer Code (Legislative Decree 206/2005) and Art. 16(l) of Directive 2011/83/EU, for accommodation services with a specific date or period **the 14-day right of withdrawal for distance contracts does not apply**. Airbnb's cancellation terms apply.

## 7. Arrival, departure and documents
Check-in after 14:00; check-out by 10:00. By law (Art. 109 TULPS) all guests, including minors, must show a valid ID on arrival. Please tell us your arrival time in advance.

## 8. House rules
Guests agree to follow the property's rules shown on the website (no smoking indoors, no pets, report damage immediately, sorted waste, etc.). Daily room cleaning is not provided (towels changed every 3 days, linen every 7). Breaches may lead to termination of the stay without refund.

## 9. Liability
The operator is liable within the limits of the law. It is not liable for unattended or lost items except in cases of wilful misconduct or gross negligence. Guests are liable for damage they cause to the property.

## 10. Complaints and governing law
Complaints may be sent to ilgiardinodirosa53@gmail.com. Consumers keep any out-of-court dispute resolution rights provided by law and the courts of their place of residence or domicile. These terms are governed by Italian law.
